title: Getting Started & SQL Server Fundamentals
description: Introduction to SQL Server, core concepts, and the basics of working with the database engine.
longDescription: This module introduces you to SQL Server, its architecture, editions, services, and tools. You'll also learn about SQL Server aliases and how to navigate the SQL Server Basics overview.
whatYouLearn: Understand what SQL Server is and its architecture
Learn about Database Engine, SQLOS, and core components
Explore SQL Server editions, services, and tools
Use column and table aliases to improve query readability
